name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1496: Konyo asked for the profile sigil to be friendlier and for a tracker of who is logged in and when - and the tracker already existed: /console has shown every console online since v875, twinned with the site /visits. He had lost the key, so a fresh VISITS_KEY was set. On top: an install can now be NAMED from its own console (double-click the sigil), the name rides the presence beacon so the fleet reads Konyo MacBook instead of konyo-3, and a FLEET panel under advanced answers who is online and when each machine was last seen without leaving the console. CI runners no longer check in - the fleet was listing a GitHub VM in Boydton beside his MacBook.
